summary: The November 19, 2025 AAP 2.6 patch fixed CVE-2025-9909 (automation-gateway improper path validation allowing credential exfiltration) and CVE-2025-59530 (receptor quic-go crash from a premature HANDSHAKE_DONE frame).
questions: Which CVEs were fixed in the November 19, 2025 AAP patch?
Which AAP release fixes the gateway credential exfiltration CVE?

answer_card.title: CVEs fixed in AAP 2.6 patch November 19, 2025
answer_card.answer_md:
- **CVE-2025-9909** (`automation-gateway`): improper path validation in gateway allows credential exfiltration (AAP-53584)
- **CVE-2025-59530** (`receptor`): `quic-go` crash due to premature `HANDSHAKE_DONE` frame (AAP-55973)

Upgrade to the November 19, 2025 patch (installer 2.6-3) or later.
